title: Founder's Package Outfits in MapleStory Classic World
intro: Which Founder's Package tier has each outfit in MapleStory Classic World, plus Manji's five pieces and the October 14 and November 30 deadlines.

blocks.p: [[img:60193dfb38529f.png]] **The three Founder's Package outfits are spread across the tiers. Only the $79.99 Zakum Package has all three.** Snail ($29.99) has the Well-Loved Outfit Set. Orange Mushroom ($59.99) adds the Founder's Thief Outfit Set, and Zakum adds Manji's Outfit Set on top. All three are permanent cosmetics with no stats. Every job and gender can wear them.

table: Claim it from the in-game mailbox

blocks.p: Nexon's webstore sells all three tiers. Steam sells only the Zakum Package.
Manji's Outfit Set comes only in the $79.99 Zakum Package. It has five pieces.

blocks.cap: All five pieces on a NiaMeowDB avatar.

blocks.p: Every NiaMeowDB account already has all five pieces in our Fashion tools, and new accounts get them when they sign up. Try the look on your profile avatar in the Appearance Builder before you pick a tier.
The Founder's Thief Outfit Set comes in the $59.99 Orange Mushroom Package and the $79.99 Zakum Package. Here it is in Nexon's reveal art.
Every Founder's Package has the Well-Loved Outfit Set, down to the $29.99 Snail Package. It is the only outfit set in the Snail Package.

ul: Buy or upgrade by 11:59 PM PDT on October 14.
Claim the package from your in-game mailbox between October 6, when Founder's Access starts, and 11:59 PM UTC on November 30.

Webstore upgrades from Orange Mushroom to Zakum made between October 6 and the October 14 sales close deliver the extra Zakum items to your mailbox at your next login, once the purchase is confirmed. You cannot pay for a Founder's Package with NX.
You can claim once per account on each platform: once on the Nexon website and once on Steam.
Leave Maple Island first, then open the package within 30 days of claiming it.
Read the full claim rules in Nexon's Founder's Packages announcement.
